verdicts.line: You walked. The ground remembered you.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: you walk and the ground remembers you
verdicts.reason: Direct echo of the tutorial narration's instrumentation register, stating the mechanical consequence (ground remembers) without interpretation.

verdicts.line: You raised the flame, and they answered.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: as each verb is first used, it is named and its consequence stated plainly
verdicts.reason: Says 'they answered' without stating what mechanical consequence the flame produces — could mean anything in any god-game.
verdicts.correction: You raised the flame. It applied what you felt.

verdicts.line: You slept where light could reach them.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: where you sleep, your light keeps working
verdicts.reason: States the mechanical consequence of the Sleep verb (light continues working at location) in plain instrumentation register.

verdicts.line: The world moved. You moved with it.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Waking is the emotional centerpiece. The landscape is the same, but different — a generation has passed, and the world has moved on its own.
verdicts.reason: Describes the player moving with the world when the chunks establish the player wakes to find the world moved *without* them — inverts the core asymmetry.
verdicts.correction: The world moved without you. You woke to what it became.

verdicts.line: You spent everything. They built the rest.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: what you find instead is the answer to what you did and what the world did without you
verdicts.reason: States the mechanical split between player action budget and autonomous world growth that defines the Sleep consequence.

verdicts.line: What you felt, they carried forward.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: as each verb is first used, it is named and its consequence stated plainly
verdicts.reason: Uses 'what you felt' as metaphor when the chunks demand plain statement of mechanical consequence — no verb is named.
verdicts.correction: The flame applied what you felt. They became it.

verdicts.line: You chose, and the land turned.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the land itself has turned — green and growing where hope took root, sharp and industrial where fear did
verdicts.reason: States the mechanical consequence of alignment choice on landscape transformation without interpretation.

verdicts.line: They stopped wandering. You showed them why.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: waiting teaches people you don't matter
verdicts.reason: Inverts the waiting consequence — chunks say waiting teaches them you don't matter (they ignore you), not that you showed them why to stop wandering.
